Sample_data_processing: The raw reads were first cleaned by removing adapter sequences, trimming low quality ends, and filtering reads with low quality (phred quality <20) using Trimmomatic (Version 0.36).

Sequence pseudoalignment of the resulting high-quality reads to the Mouse reference genome (build GRCm38.p6 with the gene annotations downloaded on 2019-11-05 from GENCODE M23) and quantification of transcript level expression was carried out using Kallisto (Version 0.44).
The Kallisto options were "--bias --bootstrap-samples 10 --seed 42 --single --rf-stranded --fragment-length 150 --sd 70".
Assembly: mm10/GRCm38.p6
Supplementary files format and content: tab-delimited txt-file including Raw and normalized Transcript Counts from Kallisto
Sample_extract_protocol_ch1: Immediately after dissection, sciatic nerves were placed in ice-cold PBS, the epineurium and perineurium were removed as much as possible, and nerves were snap-frozen in 1.5ml microcentrifugation tubes using liquid nitrogen. Prior to RNA purificaton, the endoneurium-enriched nerves were mechanically grinded to a powder while frozen using an RNAse free pestle. Total RNA was extracted using Qiazol, for as per manufacturer’s instructions.
RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using Illumina's TruSeq Stranded mRNA

Series_overall_design: The dataset was generated with sciatic nerves extracted from mice at 5 days of age (P5). The genotypes analyzed include 4 independent control animals  ( Nedd4tm3.1Bros flox/flox) and 4 independent conditional Nedd4 knockout animals in the SC-lineage  (Tg(Mpz-cre)26Mes +/- :  Nedd4tm3.1Bros flox/flox), abbreviated as mpzNedd4cKO.
Series_summary: RNA sequencing was performed to evaluate the transcriptome of sciatic nerves extracted from mice with conditional deletion of Nedd4 in the SC-lineage during development.
Series_title: Transcriptomics analysis of sciatic nerves with conditional deletion of Nedd4 in the Schwann cell (SC) lineage during development.
Series_type: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing
